items.t: Jerky, harsh or slipping shifts from the 9-speed automatic
items.job: Transmission fluid service and software update, valve body if needed
items.note: Estimate. Low end is a fluid service; a full transmission replacement can run $3,000-$6,000.

items.t: Transmission slow to upshift or downshift
items.job: Transmission software update and shift relearn

items.t: Thermostat fault with Reduced Steering Assist message
items.job: Replace thermostat housing and refill coolant
items.note: Estimate. YourMechanic lists about $384-$553 for a coolant flush alone.

items.t: Stalling or no start from a failed fuel pump control module
items.job: Replace fuel pump control module
items.note: Estimate. If the fuel pump or injectors are also damaged, cost goes up.

items.t: Automatic braking slams on while backing up
items.job: Rear sensor check and software update

items.t: Hesitation pulling away from a stop or after auto stop
items.job: Test or replace 12-volt AGM battery, update software
items.note: Estimate. The low end is testing and a software update.

items.t: Rear toe links wear out early
items.job: Replace rear toe links and align

items.t: Transmission fluid leak from faulty transmission bolts
items.job: Reseal transmission bolts and top up fluid
items.note: Estimate; should be covered by the new-car warranty.
